title: Login page returns 500 Internal Server Error
body: When I try to login using Chrome browser, I get a 500 Internal Server Error. This started happening after the last deployment. Safari works fine. Tried clearing cookies but no luck.

title: Add dark mode to the dashboard
body: It would be great if the dashboard had a dark mode option. Many of us work late hours and the bright white background causes eye strain. Maybe a toggle in settings?

title: How do I export my data?
body: I need to export all my project data as CSV. Where can I find the export option? I looked in settings but couldn't find it. Help please.

title: Payment failed - credit card charged but subscription not activated
body: I tried to upgrade to Pro plan. My credit card was charged $29.99 but the subscription shows as 'Free' still. This is urgent - I need the Pro features for a client presentation tomorrow.

title: Dashboard loading extremely slow
body: The dashboard takes over 30 seconds to load. It used to be instant. Started happening this week. Other pages seem fine. I have good internet connection.

title: Complete production outage - all APIs returning 500
